BBA Highlights
BBA is one of the most popular and sought-after bachelor's degree programs pursued by students after Class 12. A good score is required for admission to the best BBA Colleges in Amravati, Nagpur, Jalgaon, Pune, and Saikheda.
The BBA course admission is the gateway to a plethora of job opportunities in numerous sectors such as Marketing, Education, Finance, Sales, and Government to name a few.
Raisoni Education holds a good college rank for BBA Colleges in Nagpur and Amravati.
BBA is a three-year professional undergraduate course in Business Management.
It is open to students from all three streams: Science, Arts, and Commerce. The BBA admission process offers knowledge and training in management and leadership skills to prepare students for managerial roles and entrepreneurship.
Raisoni is among the top BBA colleges with direct admission in Central India.

BBA Course Eligibility
Aspirants who have completed their Class 12 in any stream from a recognised educational board or university can take admission to BBA. A good score confirms BBA Admission 2026 in top colleges.
The candidates must have attained a minimum of 50% aggregate and above in Class 12.
In case a candidate has appeared for the Class 12 exam and is waiting for the results, he/she can also apply for BBA in the top universities.
For students looking for BBA colleges direct admission, BBA forms, or details regarding BBA colleges with fees, the BBA admission process is simple and student-friendly. Those interested in direct admission in BBA can explore opportunities at Raisoni Education, one of the leading institutions for BBA admission in the university.

BCA Highlights
BCA is a three-year undergraduate degree programme for candidates wishing to delve into the world of Computer languages.
One of the most popular options to get started with a career in Information Technology, the BCA course gives you an insight into the world of computers and their applications.
Specialisations Offered (1)
BCA
BCA Course Eligibility
Aspirants must have passed 10+2 from any stream with Maths as a compulsory subject with a minimum of 45% to 55% marks in aggregate (the pass percentage might vary from college to college).
While some BCA colleges and BCA universities admit aspirants on a merit basis, others admit students based on personal interviews and BCA admission entrance exams.
For those seeking BCA Admission 2026, the BCA admission process is straightforward. Students can explore direct admission in BCA at BCA colleges in Amravati and BCA colleges in Nagpur.
Interested students can fill out the application for BCA at the best colleges for BCA direct admission. Those looking for BCA direct admission colleges can check BCA admission details and BCA full information through the university portals.
Whether you are looking for bachelor of computer application admission, BCA course admission, or admission to BCA course, various colleges offer opportunities with different eligibility criteria and processes. Apply today and kickstart your journey in the IT industry!

Testimonials
Empowering to lift your career beyond reach & expectations with our thoughtfully curated B.Tech programs
The labs and other technical facilities are excellent here. Faculty members are expert and helpful. College organises various curriculums which are helpful in personality development. Curriculums are relevant to studies and also make students ready for industry. College offers various events, learnathons, courses by industrial experts, arrange talk sessions with experts, etc. College has good placements. Aptitude and placement training is provided for placements. There are many innovative cells in college such as training and placement cell, association cell, innovation cell, etc.
Madhav Mundada
The faculty in this college are very well experienced and helpful towards the students. I personally never felt like any of my questions towards the faculty was skipped or made felt unimportant. Also the college Training and placement department is very open to how it works and is always willing to help students with anything they need. There are regular sessions being conducted for students Skill improvement and also many industrial experts come to the college campus to share their experiences and struggles while they once were a student.
Ganesh Hulle
My experience in the GHRCEM is the best as it has provided me a great knowledge based and also enhanced the skills. Teaching patterns are properly followed throughout the year. Also there are doubt clearing sessions as per need of students. Labs are well maintained with proper setup with good internet connection. There are various activities organized by various clubs of our college. Teaching and non-teaching staff are very cooperative!!
Sakshi Gawade
The B.Tech in the department of Computer Science and Engineering offered by G.H. Raisoni College of Engineering And Management, Jalgaon has been a phenomenal experience. The curriculum and syllabus is well structured in the course offered. The faculty are outstanding and they made the learning easy and enthusiastic. They used to teach in more efficient way which helped me to build skills and made me more confident. Their mentoring provided the gateway to enter the industry in which I am always interested to build a career. Truly GHRECM provides a great exposure to students to showcase their skills and helps in developing the knowledge in order to achieve their dreams. Apart from education the college ambience itself helps to build values and to develop interpersonal skills.
